In addition we are proposing to plant several trees along the exterior of the fence which is within our boundary and is adjacent to Ferry Lane. These trees are intended to enhance the tree line, act as a deterrent to intruders and screen both the fence and some unsightly tall stumps in the neighbouring property, Ferry Lodge. I propose planting 3 Cercis Canadensis (Forest Pansy), 3 Ligustrum Lucidum Variegata, interspersed with 2 or 3 Turkish Hazel - Corylus Colurna. We will also plant some hedgerow behind the trees.
